title: Zephyr: Add CONFIG_LICHEN_SYNC_HOP Kconfig
description:
Add Kconfig options for GNSS-synchronized hopping.

## File
lichen/subsys/lichen/Kconfig (or lichen/subsys/lichen/link/Kconfig)

## Options to Add
```kconfig
config LICHEN_SYNC_HOP
    bool "Enable GNSS-synchronized frequency hopping"
    depends on LICHEN_MULTI_CHANNEL_ENABLED
    help
      When enabled, nodes use GNSS-derived time to synchronize
      frequency hopping across the network. Falls back to epoch-based
      hopping when GNSS is unavailable.

config LICHEN_SYNC_HOP_SUPERFRAME_MS
    int "Superframe duration in milliseconds"
    default 100
    depends on LICHEN_SYNC_HOP
    help
      Duration of each superframe for synchronized hopping.
      All nodes must use the same value.

config LICHEN_SYNC_HOP_SEED
    int "Hopping seed"
    default 0
    depends on LICHEN_SYNC_HOP
    help
      Seed value for the hopping sequence hash.
      All nodes in a network must use the same seed.

config LICHEN_SYNC_HOP_FALLBACK
    bool "Enable fallback to epoch-based hopping"
    default y
    depends on LICHEN_SYNC_HOP
    help
      When GNSS is unavailable, fall back to epoch-based channel
      selection instead of returning an error.
```

## Follow existing patterns
- Match style of other LICHEN Kconfig options
- Add help text for each option
